$comment: The score at fixed board ranks, for the scenarios the season pool names. Serves the post-rank board only: no season threshold is cut from this file. It exists because a percentile stops resolving at the top - the finest fraction sampled into leaderboard_percentiles.json is 0.1%, and the ladder's own hardest rank is already 0.8% - so the range a post-rank board has to separate is inside the clamp. A rank means the same thing on a board of any size, which is what a fraction stops doing up here. Re-run tools/sampleApex.ts when the pool changes.
